title: Project Aurora – Master Project Plan v2
content:
Project: Aurora | Version: 2 | Owner: Jane Smith | Last Updated: 15 January 2026

SCOPE
- Single SKU launch: Aurora 250ml (revised from 240ml at G3)
- Markets: UK, France, Germany
- Variants: Original only (fragrance variant under commercial review — decision at G4)

MILESTONES
- G2 Completed: 10 January 2026
- G3 Target: 20 February 2026 | Status: Conditionally passed
- G4 Target: 15 April 2026
- G5 Target: 01 July 2026
- G6 Target: 01 September 2026
- G7 / Launch Target: 01 October 2026

WORK BREAKDOWN STRUCTURE
1. Formulation & R&D
   1.1 Formula stability testing (owner: Marco Rossi, due: 05 Mar)
   1.2 Formula sign-off (owner: Marco Rossi, due: 20 Mar)
2. Procurement & Supply Chain
   2.1 Supplier lead time confirmation (owner: Sarah Chen, due: 03 Mar)
   2.2 Purchase orders issued (owner: Sarah Chen, due: 01 Apr)
3. Packaging
   3.1 Dieline update for 250ml (owner: Lisa Park, due: 10 Mar)
   3.2 Artwork finalisation (owner: Lisa Park, due: 25 Mar)
4. Quality & Compliance
   4.1 G3 compliance sign-off (owner: Tom Walsh, due: 07 Mar)
   4.2 Regulatory submissions FR/DE (owner: Tom Walsh, due: 15 Mar)
5. Project Management
   5.1 Governance board update (owner: Jane Smith, due: 28 Feb)
   5.2 G4 readiness review (owner: Jane Smith, due: 12 Mar)

KEY DEPENDENCIES
- 1.2 depends on 1.1
- 4.1 depends on 1.1
- 3.1 depends on 2.1
- 3.2 depends on 3.1

BUDGET
- Approved budget: €1.2M
- Committed to date: €340K
- Forecast at completion: €1.18M
